heading: What Clients Say.
description: Feedback from people who committed to the process.
demoNote: These testimonials are sample placeholders for demonstration and do not represent real clients.

items.name: Amaya Perera
items.feedback: Sajith made training feel achievable from day one. The plan fit my work schedule and for the first time I actually stuck with it long enough to see real change.

items.name: Ruwan Silva
items.feedback: Every session had a purpose. My lifts went up every few weeks and the technique coaching completely fixed my shoulder pain on bench.

items.name: Tharushi Fernando
items.feedback: I live outside Colombo, so online coaching was perfect. Quick video feedback and weekly check-ins kept me accountable the whole way.

items.name: Chamath Jayasuriya
items.feedback: Not just a trainer — a coach who genuinely cares. Six months in, I've changed how I eat, sleep and train. Best investment I've made.
